criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.rationale: First paragraph (204 chars, essentially the full pre-'see more' window) names subject, role, org, and the decision itself, and plants the conflict ('He ran DNR until 2025') in the same breath. The decision is the hook.

criteria.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria.rationale: Boyle is a public-facing decision-owner on a $10B+, 1GW+ North Slope project. The post names sector, dollar figure, affected actors (North Slope Borough, hyperscalers pricing Alaska power into 2027), and a timeframe.

criteria.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria.rationale: Full name, title, organization, and DNR tenure (2023-2025) all match the dossier exactly. Anchorage tie stated twice.

criteria.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria.rationale: Decision is dated, sourced by name to ADN, and the binary is described concretely. Held to 8 rather than 9-10 because the corroboration underlying the decision is thin (ADN and Northern Journal share the same Nathaniel Herz reporting per the validation note), a limitation of the record the post does not paper over but also does not fully surface.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.rationale: Genuinely steelmans the sharp reading before turning to the mediocre position. Lands a falsifiable position without manufacturing scandal, matching the post_001.md structural-read energy.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.rationale: Names the next decision (DNR's Finding and Decision), is honest that no date has been announced, and gives a concrete trigger to watch plus named readers.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.rationale: Analytical, structural, business-literate cadence consistent with post_001.md. No press-release recap, no LinkedIn-influencer tone, no hagiography.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.rationale: Word count (454) and char count (2842) both land inside range, and most paragraphs are tight, but the quote-heavy third paragraph runs to roughly 129 words in a single block, which reads as a wall of text on mobile.
criteria.fix: Split the long quote-and-figures paragraph into two shorter paragraphs to ease mobile scanning.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.rationale: Closing question is specific, debatable, and tied directly to the decision, with no CTA softener.

criteria.name: Credibility guard
criteria.rationale: Bio recap is two sentences and the bulk of the post is decision treatment. Every factual claim traces to the dossier's cleared figures and quotes, and the critique is earned by the evidence rather than invented or recycled.

notes: All nine hard-fail checks pass, including the four cleared figures ($10B+, 1GW+, roughly one square mile, July 17 deadline) with none of the forbidden numbers ($500M, 3GW, 715.4 acres) appearing, and exactly three verbatim subject quotes with no invention. The post correctly handles the known corroboration soft spot by naming only ADN and never overclaiming multi-outlet confirmation, so it was graded honestly on Decision specificity rather than hard-failed. The post lands the intended 'mediocre' position (ordinary triage, wrong messenger) with a genuine steelman-then-turn structure and no manufactured scandal. Weighted total 8.76 clears the 8.0 threshold on the first scoring pass; the only real drag is a dense quote-heavy paragraph under Readability.
